en.title: Hour of the Deep Sea Sediment: The Ancient Afterglow Melting into the Rainy City
en.premise: In a seaside town where the ebb and flow of the tide dictates fate lie the ruins of a long-sunken ancient civilization. A disgraced former inspector, an apothecary who appears only on rainy days, and a diver seeking truth in the deep sea—three different forms of justice intersect over a taboo relic unearthed from the underwater ruins. As the rain ceaselessly pours and the fathomless abyss of the sea looms, people's pride is relentlessly put to the test.

zh.title: 溟海沉淀之时：溶于雨街的往昔残照
zh.premise: 在一个潮汐左右命运的海边小镇，沉睡着昔日沉没的古代文明遗迹。被剥夺名誉的前巡察官、只在雨天现身的药材商，以及在深海中探寻真相的潜水士。三种不同的正义，因从海底遗迹中浮现的禁忌遗物而交织在一起。绵延不绝的雨水与深不见底的海渊，正无情地考验着人们的尊严与傲骨。
